{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Define sentinel value
SENTINEL = -999.0

# Create a mask for sentinel values in baseline biomarker
sentinel_mask = data['biomarker_baseline'] == SENTINEL

# Count how many patients have sentinel values
num_sentinel = sentinel_mask.sum()
print(f"Number of patients with sentinel values in baseline: {num_sentinel}")

# Check how many of these are in each arm
sentinel_by_arm = data[sentinel_mask]['arm'].value_counts()
print("Sentinel values by arm:")
print(sentinel_by_arm)

# Check how many of these are in each severity category
sentinel_by_severity = data[sentinel_mask]['severity'].value_counts()
print("Sentinel values by severity:")
print(sentinel_by_severity)

# Check how many of these are in each sex
sentinel_by_sex = data[sentinel_mask]['sex'].value_counts()
print("Sentinel values by sex:")
print(sentinel_by_sex)

# Check if the sentinel values are associated with response
sentinel_response_rate = data[sentinel_mask]['responded'].mean()
print(f"Response rate among patients with sentinel values: {sentinel_response_rate:.3f}")

# Check if the sentinel values are associated with treatment
sentinel_treatment_rate = data[sentinel_mask]['arm'].value_counts(normalize=True)['treatment']
print(f"Proportion of sentinel patients in treatment arm: {sentinel_treatment_rate:.3f}")"}
